specs.name: findMajorityElement_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond ≠ -1 →
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond ∈ lst

specs.name: findMajorityElement_majority_count
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond ≠ -1 →
    (lst.filter (fun y == y = findMajorityElement lst h_precond)).length > lst.length / 2

specs.name: findMajorityElement_unique_majority
specs.stmt:
∀ lst.all (fun x == (lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length = lst.length / 2 ∧
                      x = findMajorityElement lst h_precond)

specs.name: findMajorityElement_none_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond = -1 ↔
    lst.find? (fun x == countOccurrences x lst > lst.length / 2) = none

specs.name: findMajorityElement_eq_find
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond =
    (lst.find? (fun x == countOccurrences x lst > lst.length / 2)).getD (-1)

specs.name: findMajorityElement_result_or_neg_one
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement lst h_precond = -1 ∧ findMajorityElement lst h_precond ∈ lst

specs.name: findMajorityElement_count_filter
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    let r := findMajorityElement lst h_precond
    r ≠ -1 →
    countOccurrences r lst = lst.length / 2

specs.name: findMajorityElement_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h : findMajorityElement_precond lst),
    findMajorityElement_postcond lst (findMajorityElement lst h) h

specs.name: findMajorityElement_is_majority
specs.stmt: theorem findMajorityElement_is_majority : (lst.filter (fun y => y = findMajorityElement lst hpre)).length * 2 > lst.length

specs.name: findMajorityElement_precond_iff
specs.stmt:
findMajorityElement_precond lst ↔
    ∃ x : Int, lst.count x * 2 = lst.length
